articleTitle: Numerical Analysis of Wind Turbine Airfoil Aerodynamic of Wind Turbine Blade
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Mechatronics System and Robots (ICMSR)
abstract: Wind energy is one of the low-cost renewable energies when compared with other sources. Malaysia with its low mean wind speed is suitable for small-scale wind turbines. This project analyzed aerodynamic performance in two types of airfoils to figure out the aerodynamic efficiency of the wind turbines. NACA 4412 airfoil and SG 6043 airfoil used FLUENT ANSYS analysis to determine the critical angle of attack. With various angles of attack, lift coefficients and drag coefficients were calculated. The lift-to-drag ratio was determined to get a critical angle of attack. SG 6043 airfoil with a 6° angle of attack showed better performance where the maximum lift-to-drag ratio of 40.1547, was found to be higher than NACA 4412 airfoil.

articleTitle: Design and Verification of a Force Generating Device Based on Intellectualization
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Mechatronics System and Robots (ICMSR)
abstract: In this paper, General standard of electronic weighing instrument professional force measuring equipment is standard weight, inconvenient transportation, poor safety. This paper introduces a force generation device based on the fusion of load cell comparison method and intelligent technology. The mass value of the load cell of the standard load cell and the measured electronic scale is compared to determine the accuracy of the measured scale and realize the intelligent detection of the calibrated scale. After repeatability and stability verification, the device can meet the automatic detection of weighing instruments with a measurement range of 0 ~ 160kg, and has the characteristics of small size, light weight, and easy to carry. It realizes the intelligent detection of weighing instruments and the innovation of force measuring device technology, and has broad market prospects. Finally, it puts forward the prospect of the digital and intelligent transformation and upgrading of electronic weighing instruments in the future under the background of 5G technology, artificial intelligence and independent chip development.

articleTitle: A Measurement and Accuracy Evaluation Method for Internal Dam Settlement
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Mechatronics System and Robots (ICMSR)
abstract: Dams are an important part of the transportation infrastructure. There are many deficiencies in the traditional methods for monitoring the internal deformation of rockfill dams, and it is difficult for the traditional methods to meet the needs of 300m ultra-high rockfill dams. In this paper, we propose a method of internal settlement measurement and accuracy evaluation of rockfill dam based on a pipeline robot. The results of the accuracy evaluation show that the method of internal settlement measurement and accuracy evaluation of rockfill dam based on a pipeline robot has great internal precision and external accuracy, reaching 10.53 ppm and 11.9 ppm, respectively. This method has better validity, stability, and accuracy than the traditional monitoring method based on the water level settlement gauge and is a new internal deformation monitoring method for rockfill dams with good application prospects.

articleTitle: Application of Improved GA-BPNN Algorithm for Forward Kinematics Problem Solving of Parallel Robots
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Mechatronics System and Robots (ICMSR)
abstract: Parallel robot forward kinematics problem is usually difficult to solve because they involve highly coupled nonlinear systems of equations. In order to solve the forward kinematic solution of the parallel mechanism quickly and accurately, an improved method combining GA-BP and Newton Raphson is proposed in this paper for the forward kinematics solution of parallel robots. The method can avoid the defect that the Newton Raphson numerical method is prone to iterative scattering due to improper selection of initial values. It can also improve the computational efficiency and numerical stability. This paper took a 3-RRR planar parallel robot as the research object, first transformed the initial multi-objective solution model into a single-objective optimization model, and then used the method proposed in the paper to solve the forward kinematics problem. Finally, the effectiveness of the method is verified by computational cases and simulation results.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Focusing and Pointing Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Mechatronics System and Robots (ICMSR)
abstract: In order to improve the pointing servo tracking accuracy of light and small remote sensing cameras, and to overcome the interference of stray flash caused by the environment to the imaging of remote sensing cameras, this paper proposes a pointing control and servo technology that enables auto focus. Using this technology, utilizing PCI, an image-based automatic lens control system allowing zooming, focusing, and adjusting aperture is realized. After manual zooming, the system can use the simplified image energy gradient function and sparse image feature sharpness optimization algorithm to achieve autofocus according to image characteristics. The implementation results show that, compared with the traditional energy gradient algorithm, this method can accelerate the calculation speed by 10 times, effectively ensure the imaging quality, avoid stray light interference. It expands the application range of light and small remote sensing cameras, and improves their functions and performance.

articleTitle: Automation and sensor control for an aquaponic system in the rural town of de San José de Quero district, Peru 2021
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Mechatronics System and Robots (ICMSR)
abstract: In the localities of the district of San José de Quero, which are currently affected by severe climate changes such as drought, frost, or others, which, in order to supply food to their livestock, in less time, space, with a higher quality protein supplement and to produce other foods that are not produced in the area by the climate, it was proposed to design an automated and sensor-controlled aquaponic chamber based by an On-Off controller. The design detailed the arrangement of sensors and actuators, using Python language that was controlled through a Raspberry Pi applied by an On-Off controller, the harmony of sensors and actuators were achieved through a mathematical analysis supported by the knowledge of 2 systems such as aquaculture and hydroponics, the combination of this is called aquaponics. As a result, in aquaculture, it was possible to simulate the control of the water level and control the temperature, pH, and oxygen ranges, in hydroponics it was possible to control the humidity and temperature, making the aquaponic system create favorable conditions for the growth and development of the plants. In summary, constant control of sensors and actuators was obtained in a Raspberry Pi proving to be robust for the development of the aquaponic system in an industrial way, achieving the automation of the camera.

articleTitle: Hybrid Adaptive Control of an Unbalanced Tilting-rotors Quadcopter Transporting a Payload via an Elastic Cable
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Mechatronics System and Robots (ICMSR)
abstract: Aerial load transportation using quadcopters is a topic of great interest to the robotics community due to its many potential civilian and military applications. This paper presents a nonlinear nine-degree-of-freedom mathematical model for an unbalanced tilting-rotors quadcopter with a suspended load via an elastic cable, where the quadcopter’s center of gravity and sling-load suspension point are assumed arbitrarily shifted from the quadcopter’s geometric center. The transportation mission is decomposed into six discrete stages, namely Payload Setup, Carrier Alignment, Payload Pick-up, Payload Conveyance, Payload Delivery, and Carrier Landing. Subsequently, a hybrid control technique is proposed, and applied through nonlinear simulations to a case study. The simulation results showed the effectiveness of the proposed controller in achieving satisfactory performance, with acceptable control effort, for the carrier-payload system through a full transportation mission.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Rolling Bearings Based on Total Vector Convolutional Recurrent Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Mechatronics System and Robots (ICMSR)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of rolling bearing fault diagnosis, this paper analyzes the application of full vector convolutional recurrent neural network in rolling bearing diagnosis. Firstly, the operation principle of convolutional recurrent neural network is introduced, and its value for fault diagnosis of rolling bearing is understood. Secondly, the main points of fault diagnosis of full vector convolutional recurrent neural network are introduced, and the faults and characteristic frequencies of rolling bearing faults are analyzed, so as to point out the direction for making a diagnosis scheme. Finally, a full vector convolutional recurrent neural network model is analyzed and constructed for diagnosing rolling bearing faults. In this paper, the advantages of full vector spectrum are applied to improve the diagnostic efficiency and automation level of rolling bearings, and to accumulate experience for the innovation of rolling bearing diagnostic technologies and methods in the future.

articleTitle: Simulation and Validation of A Dual-motor Coupled Joint Actuator
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Mechatronics System and Robots (ICMSR)
abstract: Flat motor + planetary reducer and flat motor + harmonic reducer are two typical driving configurations of joint actuators in many robotic applications. Nevertheless, they still have inherent technological limitations and a new joint driving architecture is highly desirable in the robotics research community. We proposed a dual-motor coupled joint actuator aiming for better kinematics performance, fast dynamic response, and high power density. Two motors were placed at the upper and lower module of the joint actuator, and their power was coupled by a planetary reducer. The speed differential of two motors determined the joint actuator’s rotation states: speed, direction, and stop. 3D simulation shows that this new design could smoothly change motion with a 360-degree rotation range and fast dynamic response, successfully satisfying project expectations and demonstrating its usability. This new design could provide a third option in addition to mainstream configurations with improved kinetics and kinematics performance, particularly suitable as a modularized joint driving unit for various robotic applications.

articleTitle: Exploring the Use of Industrial Robots in CNC Machine Tool Programming and Operation Courses
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Mechatronics System and Robots (ICMSR)
abstract: CNC machine tools (Note: CNC’s full name is Computer Numerical Control, hereinafter referred to as CNC) is the core equipment of modern manufacturing, in the cutting and processing of moulds and mechanical parts, has an irreplaceable position. For a long time, CNC machine tools have been put into production processing individually or in bulk. In recent years, with the rapid development of new technologies, industrial robots have also been developed rapidly and put into use in various fields, and CNC machine tools and industrial robots are gradually combined into a whole. In CNC machining, the use of industrial robots maximises the inherent potential of CNC machine tools, making them simpler, more stable and more efficient. For the operator, the intervention of industrial robots makes the operation of CNC machine tools increasingly difficult, not only ensuring processing quality, but also improving processing efficiency. Robotics and CNC machining machine tools are a combination of robotics and CNC technology, enabling the machine tool to have a variety of features and functions of the robot at the same time, while the robot can have similar characteristics to the operator. This makes the combination of robotics and CNC machining machine tools more functional and powerful. It also reduces the manual labour intensity and improves the safety of industrial intensity. The use of industrial robots in CNC machining technology allows for better performance in the programming and manufacturing process. Not only can cutting work tasks be completed, but also precise robot operations and much more can be achieved. The use of robots improves the efficiency of industrial production and brings more convenience and profit to companies. In recent years, CNC machining technology has also developed rapidly, which in turn plays a full role in ensuring high product quality and output. For this reason, the authors analyse and explore the application of industrial robots in CNC machining technology in conjunction with the course.

articleTitle: Cooperative Neural Network Control for Uncertain Non-affine Multi-agent Systems via an Adaptive Distributed Observer
publicationTitle: 2022 7th International Conference on Mechatronics System and Robots (ICMSR)
abstract: This paper considers cooperative tracking problem of the multi-agent system modeled by a class of uncertain non-affine nonlinear systems and an autonomous nonlinear leader system. In this paper, an adaptive distributed observer was firstly designed, which could estimate the leader’s signal to various followers. Then, the non-affine system is transformed into an affine form by a low-pass filter. Finally, a simulation example is provided to verify the present controller. This controller provides three interests: it calculates the observer gain on-line to process communication barriers; the non-affine multi-agent system is transformed into affine form to overcome the control difficulty of non-affine multi-agent system; the proposed control scheme only needs two online approximators to estimate the unavailable states.
